Who are we?

Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.

We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.

Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.

Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.

We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games.

Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started.

The role is working within our studio: Ludios

About Ludios

Ludios takes its name from the Latin, it means "The Game People". Led by Eyal, one of the co-founders of Tripledot Studios, and some of the most experienced people in mobile games, we are a studio that makes and publishes our own casual, free-to-play mobile games. Our team is based across APAC, with the majority of our development happening in Jakarta and Melbourne. We are data-driven, creative, and genuinely passionate about the industry we work in. Right now, we are working on a number of exciting projects, including one built around a globally recognised IP, alongside several original titles we are equally excited about. If crafting games and reaching millions of players is what gets you out of bed, we would love to hear from you.

Role Overview

As a Community Manager, you’ll set the strategic direction and drive player engagement for an exciting upcoming casual social mobile title featuring a world-renowned brand partner. The role will be based in our Jakarta office, you will be the bridge between our players and our development team—building vibrant social communities, nurturing player loyalty, and translating player sentiment into actionable insights for our product roadmap.

Key Responsbilities

•

Define Strategy & Core Pillars: Build, execute, and scale our community engagement strategy focused on five core pillars: Player Relationships, Recognition, In-Game & Out-of-Game Events, Brand Loyalty, and Player Service.

•

Content & Social Channel Management: Plan, craft, and publish engaging, player-centric content across key social platforms (Facebook, Instagram, Discord, TikTok, X, and YouTube) tailored to casual mobile gamers.

•

Voice of the Player & Studio: Serve as the external voice of the studio and the internal advocate for the player. Synthesize community feedback, sentiment, and trends into clear, actionable reports for Product, Design, and Marketing teams.

•

Creator & Influencer Partnerships: Identify, build, and nurture 1:1 relationships with key influencers, content creators, and brand ambassadors in the casual gaming space.

•

Community Events & LiveOps Integration: Design, execute, and evaluate high-impact community events, contests, and giveaways aligned with in-game LiveOps and seasonal campaigns.

•

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Marketing, Product, Design, and external IP brand managers to ensure messaging aligns with product updates and brand guidelines.

•

Crisis & Sentiment Management: Proactively monitor channels to address player issues, mitigate crisis situations, and maintain a welcoming, positive community environment.

Required Skills, Knowledge, and Expertise

•

3+ years of experience in community management or social media strategy within the video games industry (mobile games preferred).

•

Deep Mobile Gaming Context: Familiarity with free-to-play (F2P) casual mobile game mechanics, live-ops cycles, and social engagement loops.

•

Analytical Mindset: Proven ability to analyze community metrics, sentiment data, and campaign performance to continuously optimize strategy.

•

Exceptional Communication: Fluent in English (written and verbal) with top-tier copywriting skills tailored to casual, friendly, and engaging brand voices.

•

Project Management Excellence: Strong organizational skills with a track record of managing multiple deliverables and community initiatives under tight timelines.

•

Passion for Gaming: A genuine love for casual/social games and an understanding of what makes player communities thrive.

What Makes You Stand Out (Bonus)

•

Experience working with licensed, top-tier global IPs or brand partners.

•

Hands-on experience with content tools (e.g., Adobe Photoshop, Canva, or basic video editing).

•

Experience building and moderating active Discord communities or Social Media channels for games.

•

Knowledge of web/HTML formatting and modern social media management dashboards (e.g., Sprout Social, Hootsuite, or Dash Hudson).

About the role

We are seeking a Finance & Strategy partner focused on Public Benefit and Global Affairs, working closely with our Global Affairs and Public Benefit teams. You will be the finance lead for how Anthropic plans, funds, and reports its giving and policy work: a category of spend that spans grants, philanthropy, direct programs, and policy engagement around the world. Anthropic is setting the standard for what a public benefit corporation can be at a scale no one has attempted before.

This is a build role. The budgets, funding structures, and reporting are still being designed, and you will shape them with the leaders who run this work and with partners in Legal, Tax, Corp Development and Accounting.

The strongest candidates pair rigorous corporate FP&A with a real understanding of how money moves in philanthropy and policy: foundations, grantmaking, funding vehicles, and the rules that come with them. You will be expected to bring a point of view, push back with data, and help leaders make tradeoffs across a portfolio where impact is harder to measure than revenue.

• Serve as the primary finance partner to Public Benefit and Global Affairs leaders, working with program teams and partner functions on every financial aspect of their work

• Experience in FP&A or strategic finance, ideally at a high-growth company or foundation, with meaningful time supporting philanthropy, social impact, or global affairs work

Epic makes Unreal Engine, which powers creative work across many industries, alongside some of the world's most popular games, including Fortnite and Rocket League. Through these products, ML research at Epic reaches millions of creators and players every day. AI is reshaping the games industry, and Epic Research - led by Lucia Specia and Michael Black - is at the center of that shift. We're looking for talented interns who want to be part of it.

In this role, you will

Work with our team of research scientists and engineers at the intersection of vision, language, speech processing, embodied agents, and game development to create state-of-the-art machine learning models in a range of areas - research topics of interest include:

• AI-backed interactive characters: LLMs for conversational characters, memory systems, automated evals, animation, etc.
• Game agents: vision-language-action, game-state agents, etc.
• 3D human and object tracking
• Reinforcement learning for embodied behavior
• Speech systems and conversational agents
• World building and game logic generation: video models, 2D->3D scene building, etc.

• Multi-modal diffusion models
• Player safety: AI-alignment, content moderation, etc.
• Improved user experience: personalised game recommendation, game representation, spam detection, etc.
• Content localization: (multimodal) translation, quality assurance, etc.
• Model distillation for realtime performance

What we're looking for

• An ongoing or recently completed (within the last 12 months) PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, AI or a related field
• A record of publication in top conferences/journals
• Experience implementing deep learning algorithms for problems in computer vision, natural language processing, or speech/audio processing
• Hands-on knowledge of state-of-the-art ML methods, such as Transformers, diffusion models, and reinforcement learning
• Experience with post-training foundation models, including SFT, preference training, and reinforcement learning
• Excellent coding and experimental engineering skills, including effective use of modern AI development tools
• Desirable: game development experience in either C++ or C#

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the posting location for the duration of the internship. For more information about Epic’s Early Career Program, visit epicgames.com/earlycareers. Who We Are:

We are a diverse team of developers driven by a passion for our art, united by our core values and inspired by a culture of inclusivity to build amazing games that thrill players everywhere. What We Need:

We are seeking a Lead Producer to serve as a key leader for our production team to support our content groups (concept, modelling, FX, etc) and help define external development strategies. With an increased scope and breadth relative to other production partners, you will focus on project strategy, take accountability for managing multiple areas and crafts, and play a vital role in hiring and developing top production talent. You will need to able to quickly adjust to the game’s growing needs and at times roll up your sleeves and execute at a more granular level.

The ideal candidate is an expert planner and problem solver who can seamlessly move between long-term strategy and short-term execution. Working closely with the production, studio, and discipline leadership teams, you will ensure our teams are set up for success, help set clear objectives aligned with business goals, aggressively mitigate risk, and serve as a driving force for team health, culture, and process improvement.

What You'll Do:

• Production Management & Delivery: Act as the production lead for multiple areas and crafts, taking accountability for the quality, upkeep, and timeliness of milestone deliveries from concept to completion.
• Schedule & Goal Creation: Ensure the development and upkeep of schedules, roadmaps, and department updates across your purview. Set clear objectives and assist producers in creating plans that align with project and business goals while driving continued planning improvements.

Need to ensure producers own their day-to-day responsibilities, uphold the "Production Standard," eliminate bottlenecks, and track feature statuses daily.

• Process Optimization & Production Leadership: Serve as a core member of the Production Leadership Group to improve production operations, drive consistent processes, and establish pipeline improvements.
• Strategic Alignment: Partner with studio leadership on production strategy and long-term organizational vision. Ensure teams deeply understand the project's strategic vision to prevent unnecessary confusion, thrashing, or wasted effort.

• An Expert Planner & Doer: An opportunistic self-starter who "flies at a higher altitude," expertly discerning must-haves from nice-to-haves and shifting focus seamlessly between micro, macro, and global project levels.
• A Model Collaborator & Diplomat: A pillar of integrity, trusted ally, and an advisor to leads and directors who listens to all sides free from personal attachment, excels at navigating different personalities, and compromises when faced with competing priorities.

• A Highly Skilled Listener: Self-aware, emotionally mature, and able to quickly get to the heart of a situation and the concerns of those involved while encouraging team-wide open communication in a controlled, safe setting.
• A Refined Eye for Quality: Possesses an expert eye for visual and functional quality, bringing a high-level perspective of big-picture goals to decision-making and issue resolution.

• Level of Experience: A seasoned, senior production leader that not only upholds the established standards of excellence but helps develop and improve upon them.

We’re looking for someone who lives and breathes social media - someone who knows what people are talking about, understands why content works, and has strong instincts for what a brand should (and shouldn’t) participate in. You’ll help manage content calendars across multiple brands, spot trends and real-time opportunities, partner with creators, and turn brand priorities into content people actually want to watch, share, and talk about.

The ideal candidate is equal parts creative thinker, trend spotter and highly organized doer. You don’t need years of traditional marketing experience - what matters most is strong social instincts, an eye for great content and a serious appetite to learn. (Bonus points if you love coffee!) You’re curious, resourceful and ready to roll up your sleeves, whether that means pitching an idea, building a content calendar, grabbing a phone to capture content, or occasionally jumping in front of the camera yourself. You’re ready to figure things out, make things happen and help our brands move at the speed of social.

This individual will report to the Senior Manager, Social Media and work closely with brand teams, creators, agencies and cross-functional partners across the North American Coffee Marketing organization - learning firsthand how to take a great social idea from cultural opportunity to execution within a large, fast-moving organization.

What you will do:

Organic Social Content & Calendar Management

• Support the day-to-day management and execution of organic social content calendars across the Coffee portfolio, ensuring content is timely, relevant and aligned with established brand and social priorities.

• Partner with brand teams and the broader cross-functional team to translate marketing strategies, product launches and business priorities into social-first content.

• Support content from idea through execution, including briefing, copy development, asset coordination, feedback, approvals, publishing and performance learnings.

• Support day-to-day publishing and content operations, including scheduling, asset management, approvals and cross-functional follow-ups.

• Help ensure content feels native to each platform and is built for how people actually consume and engage with social.

• Help capture and develop quick-turn, mobile-first social content, including behind-the-scenes, trend-led and real-time content.

• Maintain content calendars, briefs, trackers and other working documents to keep social programs organized and moving across multiple brands.

Culture, Trends & Real-Time Marketing

• Stay deeply plugged into social culture, emerging trends, memes, formats, creators, platform behaviors and conversations relevant to our brands and audiences.

• Identify trends and cultural opportunities early, surface them to the broader team and help develop potential ways our brands could participate.

• Support our weekly cross-functional Social Newsroom by monitoring social and culture, identifying emerging trends and conversations, and bringing forward relevant examples and opportunities for consideration.

• Monitor competitor and best-in-class brand activity to identify emerging creative approaches, platform behaviors and potential opportunities for the Coffee portfolio.

• Help foster a test-and-learn mindset by surfacing new formats, creative approaches and platform capabilities worth experimenting with.

• Support quick-turn content development when relevant trends, conversations or cultural moments emerge.

Creator & Content Development

• Help identify, brief and coordinate social-first content creators who support always-on organic content across the portfolio.

• Partner with internal teams, agencies and creators to help develop content that feels authentic to each brand while remaining native to social.

• Support the creative development process by providing thoughtful, social-first feedback and coordinating revisions and approvals.

• Identify opportunities to capture, repurpose and adapt content quickly across platforms and brands.

• Support the development and execution of quick-turn content in response to emerging trends and cultural moments.

• Help coordinate creator deliverables, timelines, assets and other day-to-day needs to keep content moving.

Community & Brand Voice

• Partner closely with Community Management teams to help ensure our brands show up consistently and authentically across social.

• Help identify proactive community engagement opportunities where our brands can join relevant conversations, interact with other brands and creators, and build brand love.
